verdict.rationale: Lindy's routines docs say you can "set a schedule or trigger once" and Lindy runs the job on autopilot, which suggests some first-party trigger mechanism for automations. Nothing documents which events can fire a trigger or how to configure one, and the always-on Gmail triage is a built-in feature rather than a user-defined event-triggered workflow. Missing for 10: documented event triggers from connected apps (new CRM record, new message, new email, form submission), trigger configuration details, and independent or hands-on corroboration.

support.subject: As an ops user, I can trigger workflows from events in connected apps (new record, message, email, form submission)

citations.quote: Lindy routines turn your recurring work into hands-off automation — set a schedule or trigger once, and Lindy runs the whole job for you on autopilot
